author: SuperCarlinBrothers
description:
Y’all the second Harry Potter  and the Philosopher's Stone HBO trailer is HERE, and it gave us our biggest look yet at the new series! From Hogwarts and the Sorting Ceremony to the BURROW, Quidditch, classes, the Mirror of Erised and even the Philosopher's Stone, there is a TON to break down.

Today we're going frame-by-frame through the new Harry Potter trailer to breakdown everything you missed, all the hidden details, book references, character reveals and BIG changes from the original Harry Potter movies!
#HarryPotter #supercarlinbrothers
